name: Budget-Centered Training
definition: A training approach that trains the densifier directly at the 'knee' of the capacity floor curve (N*), so the model is born at the right size instead of growing huge and being pruned afterwards.
summary: Budget-Centered Training initializes 3D Gaussian Splatting at the optimal primitive count and enforces a hard budget cap, replacing gradient-based pruning with a redundancy map to eliminate wasted computation.
